tools.name: get_project_format
tools.description: How to write a Mokxi project (board, parts, wires as "partId.pin" pairs, code), with the rules, the common parts and boards with their pins, and a complete example.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: The microcontroller boards Mokxi simulates, all 45 of them, or only one family's, with each board's type for the "board" field, the code it takes, its pin names, its page on mokxi.com and Mokxi's own picture of it. The optional "family" narrows the list to one family or kind of board ("ESP32", "Ardu

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Find Mokxi parts by what they are ("temperature sensor", "oled", "motor driver"). Returns each part's type, pins and settings, from the simulator's own catalog, with Mokxi's own picture of the part where mokxi.com has one.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: One part in full: its pins with their directions, its settings with ranges and units, how a Mokxi template wires it, and Mokxi's own picture of it where mokxi.com has one.

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: A complete, working starter for a board, a part or both: a real Mokxi template, returned as a project with its wiring and code in the Mokxi AI format. With no arguments, the smallest whole project.

tools.name: validate_project
tools.description: Check a project the way the Mokxi editor does: every unknown part, wrong pin, bad setting and code problem, in plain words naming the part and pin. Returns whether the project is valid, its errors and warnings, and a summary of what it builds.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Make the link that opens the project in the Mokxi editor and runs it: the board, its code, and the parts and wires when there are any. The link carries the whole project and opens with no account. For a signed-in Mokxi account it also saves a copy as a private project (a retry within a minute return

tools.name: create_code_link
tools.description: Make a link that opens a sketch in the Mokxi editor, for code with no circuit worked out: Mokxi reads the sketch, picks the board when none is given and places and wires the parts the code names. The sketch is not checked here. Returns the link. In the editor, Upload to board then writes the sketch
